description: An F#-native MCP server for AI coding agents. Combines fsautocomplete and FSharp.Compiler.Service into one stdio process exposing a focused, intent-shaped tool surface led by `find` and `check` — paginated responses, structured error envelopes, snippet validation, and record-field audits that catch construction sites missed by textual search.
releaseNotes: See CHANGELOG.md at https://github.com/Neftedollar/FsLangMCP/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md for full release history.
